findings: Native CUDA offloads 66/66 language layers and evaluates the same 88-token prompt; it generates different greedy text from both native CPU and Overgo, correctly describing left red/right blue in this one case.

Last captured prefill layer (62) relative L2: native CPU versus native CUDA 0.1051684; Overgo versus native CPU 0.0911788; Overgo versus native CUDA 0.0620246. These are empirical comparisons, not derived acceptance tolerances or proof of all downstream correctness.

Independent first-projection F64 arithmetic on actual Overgo inputs differs from its F16 path by relative L2 0.0000606 to 0.0002601 across twelve cases; native Q8 activation quantization explains the larger native CPU first-projection deviations retained in the prior bundle.
